explication: Sublink Worker is a web-based proxy subscription manager and converter. Its main user workflow takes share links or complete client configs, parses them into proxy data, applies client-specific configuration and rules, then presents subscription links. The README also documents saved configs, short links, an automation API, and multiple deployment runtimes. The sampled sources establish parser behavior, storage operations, and runtime entry points; the application routes and UI-to-service wiring were not sampled, so those relationships are shown only where supported.
